mentions.name: Learnalist mobile client v1
mentions.description: Mobile app for Learnalist that adds an upgrade path gating 200 free flashcard entries before payment, introduces a new card-adding UX, and moves image storage to the server instead of keeping images local.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on an update to my mobile client for Learnalist, specifically bringing upgrade path to gate 200 free flashcard entries before payment. This now includes, a new add UX, embracing images on the server, not local anymore.
